parts.t: Westham Island is farmland across the river from Ladner. Its only road access is the Westham Island Bridge, which TransLink owns. So how you get on and off the island is part of buying here.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta, TransLink and the Agricultural Land Commission.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Before you buy or sell, check the zoning, what the community plan says, and which schools serve the address.

What is Westham Island known for?
Farming. The island supplies over 25% of B.C.’s seed potatoes across more than 700 hectares, and it has two wildlife areas.
How do you get to Westham Island?
The Westham Island Bridge is the island’s only road access. TransLink owns it, and it reopened on March 28, 2026 after repairs. Check current status before you buy.
Is there an official Westham Island boundary?
Westham Island is an island in the Fraser River, so the water around it marks its edges. It is also an MLS® area name with its own map lines, so ask me about a specific address.
